project.name: Invengic Studio — visual restructure
project.type: mobile-first ordering app for laser-engraved wooden keychains, used at stalls and events in India
project.goal: Rebuild the look, layout and feel of every screen so it feels warm, crafted, honest and fast — like watching your own name get burnt into real wood — while every existing behaviour keeps working.
important: This is a VISUAL restructure: layout, brand, typography, components, motion and copy tone.
Payment, order, login, queue and printer logic are out of scope. Where the visuals expose a logic problem, flag it; do not rewrite it here.
Every id, class and data attribute that js/*.js reads, writes or generates must keep working (see dom_contract).
The engraving geometry of the preview (shape outlines, hole, text box, sizes in mm) must not change — the printer relies on it.

creative_direction.positioning: Your name, burnt into real wood, while you watch.
creative_direction.personality: The proud craftsman at the fest: warm (wood, hands, a little smoke), a bit cheeky, proud of the machine, honest about time and price.
principles: What you see is what burns: the preview looks like the real piece.
Wood first: real material, real photos, burn-brown ink.
One thumb, one decision per screen, one sticky primary action.
Only true things: no fake queue numbers, fake times or anonymous reviews in the new copy.
Calm chrome, loud product: the keychain is always the brightest, largest thing.
voice_examples: This is exactly what the laser will burn.
Ready! Show your token at the counter.

char.role: text, icons, focus ring (15.9:1 on birch)

ember.role: primary button fill; ALWAYS char label, never white; never text on birch

ember_deep.role: ember text and links on light backgrounds (4.6:1)

brand_tokens.ratio_rule: About 60% birch/kraft, 30% char/walnut, at most 10% ember. No gradients, glows, glass or grid backgrounds.
brand_tokens.rule: Colours only through CSS custom properties; no hard-coded hex outside the token block.

engraving_fonts.rule: Product fonts used inside the preview only (Montserrat, Bebas Neue, Pacifico, Permanent Marker, Press Start 2P, Noto Emoji). Keep loading them for the preview; never use them for UI.
engraving_fonts.default: Keep the existing default engraving font unless the preview code makes a change trivial; a new default is a logic change and out of scope.

rules: Sentence case for UI; no tracked all-caps labels except tiny meta tags
Tabular figures for prices and tokens

rules: Flat, one colour, closed paths (burnable on the CV-01 Pro)

dom_contract.source: docs/UI_MAP.md (sections 3-5 are the full list, with file:line for every reader)
rules: Keep every id app.js dereferences at load without a null check (#home-btn, #btn-start, #emoji-panel, #emoji-toggle, #char-current, #name-input, #crop-*, #rotate-*, #img-canvas, #img-dropzone, #img-file, #img-threshold, #threshold-value, #img-invert, #remove-image, #img-keychain, #img-controls, #img-error, #img-coverage, #btn-pay, #btn-pay-image, #live-queue, #btn-notify and the four screen sections). One missing id stops the rest of app.js.
Screens switch only through .screen.active and body[data-screen]; modals and panels only through the hidden attribute, and [hidden]{display:none !important} must stay.

Listeners are bound once at load to .shape-card[data-shape-id], .hero-sample-item[data-shape] inside #hero-canvas, .footer-link-shape[data-shape] and .footer-link-mode[data-mode]: new tappable shape or mode entry points must reuse these classes as static markup.
#keychain-svg and the first .img-overlay are rebuilt with innerHTML on every shape change: style their contents from CSS only, never add children, and keep .img-overlay unique.

No CSS typography (font-size, font-family, letter-spacing, font-weight, text-transform) may reach #keychain-text or its ancestors: the preview size and the getBBox auto-fit depend on the attributes JS sets.
#img-keychain keeps position:relative, no fixed or max height, and the inline aspect-ratio JS writes; #img-canvas is placed in % of it and shows white = burn, so it needs an inverting filter.
JS rewrites the content of #btn-add-cart-* (innerHTML), #btn-open-direct-link (textContent) and the first <span> of #btn-notify: decoration inside them must be an <svg> or a pseudo-element.
The cart drawer and overlay are un-hidden and get .active in the same tick, and are hidden 350 ms after .active is removed: open with keyframes, close with a transition shorter than 350 ms.
z-index order stays: header 50 < cart overlay 1000 < drawer 1001 < camera 1050 < crop = auth/help 1060 < toast 1100 < debug panel 99999.
Keep loading the engraving fonts (Press Start 2P, Bebas Neue, Montserrat 700, Permanent Marker, Pacifico, Noto Emoji) and the script order; never load js/keychain-shapes.js.
needs_js_to_change: emoji in JS-written labels and toasts ("🛒 Add to Cart", "✓ ✓" toasts, "📷 Custom Logo / Image", "👤/📱" profile tag)
help modal wiring (#btn-header-help has no listener; closeHelpModal is undefined), so the button is hidden
Razorpay checkout name ("Laser Keychain") and theme colour (#00e5ff)
cart thumbnail is always a rectangle, and the cart shows "Shape: undefined" (reads .title, the registry has .name)
"Actual size" caption (app.js:928) is not 1:1 at any viewport; suggest "Real size: …"; the circle caption repeats "Ø 50 mm × Ø 50 mm" (app.js:951)
Buy now adds to the cart and clears the design (both buttons call handleAddToCart)

out_of_scope: Pricing and payment logic (₹1 test amount, the cart → 'KEYCHAIN' order bug, payment verification)
Engraving geometry and fonts used by the printer
verification: Headless Chrome captures of every screen at 390×844 and 1440×900 before/after
Every flow still works: start → create → shape → name → add to cart → cart → (auth modal opens) ; image upload → crop → preview
Design critique pass on the captures
